# docs/build/

Build governance documents for the egzos Phase 0.0 scaffold and beyond. These are the
source-of-record texts that the scaffold is derived from.

## Documents in this directory

**`egzos-build-plan-v1.2.txt`**
The multi-agent build plan. Defines the roster (12 roles, 16 definitions), the orchestration
phases (0–7), the standing rhythm, and the philosophy. All agent charters in `.claude/agents/` are
derived ONLY from this text. Compiled 2026-09-03.

**`egzos-decisions-v0.6-amendments.txt`**
The v0.6 amendment set to the decisions log. Resolves the third design review and ratifies the
build handoff (R1–R11). Covers: merge gate (§J), the container authorization server (§K),
publicity and disclosure (§L), runtime topology (§M), sequencing and consistency fixes (§N),
ratified defaults (§O), and the design system and component sourcing charter (§P).
Compiled 2026-09-03.

## Earlier logs (not published)

The earlier decisions logs — v0.3, v0.4, v0.5 and the v0.5 amendment set — are internal working
documents and are not published in this repository. The v0.6 amendment set supersedes them for all
decisions that appear here; anything not mentioned in v0.6 carries forward from the earlier logs
but is internal only.

## Reading order

Read in this order to reconstruct the full decision context:

1. `egzos-decisions-v0.6-amendments.txt` — the governing amendment set (§J–§P, R1–R11)
2. `egzos-build-plan-v1.2.txt` — the build plan (roster, phases, philosophy)
